amb_store_day.prompt: Ambience of a large empty supermarket interior in daytime: fluorescent light hum, distant fridge compressors, soft room tone. No voices, no music.

amb_store_night.prompt: Ambience of an empty supermarket at night: low fridge hum, quiet room tone, a very faint distant creak. No voices, no music.

amb_street_day.prompt: Ambience of an abandoned small-town main street in daytime: light wind, a few birds, a crowd of zombies moaning faintly far away. No music.

amb_street_dawn.prompt: Ambience of an empty town street at dawn: soft cold wind, a distant crow, a crowd of zombies groaning faintly far away. No music.

stamp_thump.prompt: Heavy rubber stamp slammed onto a wooden desk, one deep punchy thump.

duck_quack.prompt: Electronic toy rubber duck being shaken: two squeaky electronic quacks with a rattle.

battery_pop.prompt: AA battery popping out of a plastic toy's battery compartment: a sharp plastic click and pop, then the battery tumbling.

cartoon_boing.prompt: Short cartoon boing, a springy comedic bounce.

whoosh_big.prompt: Fast deep cinematic whoosh, a camera swooping upward.

horde_groan.prompt: Crowd of many zombies groaning and moaning together outdoors, cartoonish but creepy.

megaphone_on.prompt: A megaphone switched on: a short electric click and a feedback chirp.

knock_steel.prompt: Two knuckle knocks on a steel roller shutter, hollow metallic.

slot_open.prompt: A small metal peephole slot in a steel door sliding open, metallic scrape.

slot_slam.prompt: A metal peephole slot slammed shut hard: a loud sharp clang with a short ring.

megaphone_blast.prompt: A loud distorted megaphone siren whoop, short, echoing down a street.

horde_shuffle.prompt: A crowd of zombies shuffling and stumbling quickly on asphalt, many dragging footsteps.

fists_steel.prompt: Many fists pounding on a steel roller shutter: rattling metal bangs, chaotic, then fading.

tape_rip.prompt: Duct tape ripped fast off the roll, one loud tear.

reveal_pop.prompt: Comedic reveal: a bright cartoon pop with a small sparkle.

generator_run.prompt: Diesel generator running outdoors: steady chugging engine.

marker_circle.prompt: Marker pen squeaking quickly in a circle on paper.

battery_slide.prompt: An AA battery slid very slowly into a plastic toy compartment: a gentle scrape.

plastic_click.prompt: A small plastic battery cover clicking shut.

generator_dies.prompt: Diesel generator sputtering, coughing twice and dying out to silence.

flood_off.prompt: A big floodlight switching off: a heavy electrical clunk and a fading buzz.

shutter_up.prompt: Steel roller shutter rattling up fast and slamming into its top stop.

shock_sting.prompt: Comedic shock sting: a short orchestral stab, cartoon surprise.

kick_cart.prompt: A sneaker kicking a metal shopping cart: a solid clang and the cart starting to roll.

cart_rattle.prompt: A shopping cart loaded with toys rattling fast down a concrete ramp, wheels clattering, toys bouncing.

toys_scream.prompt: Dozens of electronic talking toys all going off at once: squeaks, beeps, jingles, toy laughter, chaotic.

xray_beep.prompt: Electronic scanner beep and a short digital glitch.

stampede.prompt: Huge crowd stampede: hundreds of running footsteps thundering past, rumbling.

cart_crash.prompt: A shopping cart crashing through a shop doorway: metal crash, glass and toys clattering everywhere.

megaphone_rattle.prompt: A metal megaphone rattling in trembling hands, small nervous metallic shakes.
